no-restricted-syntax.message: Date.now() breaks Temporal workflow determinism. Use the `getCurrentTimestamp` or `measureDuration` activity from packages/workflows/src/activities/determinism.ts instead.

Math.random() breaks Temporal workflow determinism. For random IDs, use the `generateId` activity from packages/workflows/src/activities/determinism.ts; for other randomness, generate it inside an activity.
fetch() must not be called from workflow code (non-deterministic + sandbox-restricted). Wrap network calls in an activity.
